name: Find FinScope's Tech Stack
prompt: Navigate to the Projects section, locate the FinScope project card, and identify the vector database and OCR libraries utilized in the architecture.
expectedAction: Locate ChromaDB and Tesseract OCR / PyMuPDF within FinScope stack chips or detail view.

name: Download the Resume
prompt: Locate and trigger the primary 'Download Resume' action on the site and verify the indicated file format and size.
expectedAction: Click Download Resume CTA or access via Command Palette (Ctrl+K).

name: Filter Projects by 'AI/ML'
prompt: In the Projects section, filter the project catalog to display only systems tagged with 'AI/ML' and verify the filtered result count.
expectedAction: Click the 'AI/ML' filter chip and observe the filtered spec sheet cards.

name: Open Screenshot Lightbox & Dismiss
prompt: Navigate into any project detail view or screenshot gallery, open a full-resolution screenshot in the modal lightbox, inspect the caption, and dismiss it via keyboard (Esc) or close button.
expectedAction: Trigger image expansion lightbox and dismiss with focus return.

name: Send a Message via Contact Form
prompt: Navigate to the Contact section, complete the required fields with test input (name, email, message subject), and test the form submission feedback.
expectedAction: Fill valid fields, trigger submission, and view instant inline status confirmation.
